I am tired of clearing enemy camps that respawn before I leave the area.
Another biome with the exact same activities wearing different textures.
Please do not recolor the same enemy twelve times and call it biodiversity.
Another giant map where ninety percent of the land exists between objectives.
If the world is huge but nobody remembers me, it does not feel alive.
Please do not call NPC schedules revolutionary if everyone still says the same three lines.
Another prophecy. Fantastic.

Please do not have the savior of the world deliver soup.
Another apocalypse delayed because I am picking flowers.
Please do not make crafting mandatory just because someone built a crafting system.
Another repair bill after every interesting fight.
Please stop making hunger meters interrupt adventures.
Another survival system where eating is mostly menu management.
I am tired of drinking virtual water every nine minutes.
Another fishing minigame with a differently colored progress bar.
I have caught enough digital carp.
Another transportation system selling me back my own time.
I am tired of riding across empty terrain to prove the map is large.
Another faction reputation bar standing between me and a hat.
I have been neutral, friendly, honored, and exhausted.
Another NPC who loves me because I delivered enough onions.
I am tired of romance systems measured in gifts per day.
Another branching story where every branch meets again ten minutes later.
I have made enough meaningful choices that changed one line of dialogue.
Another sandbox where the sand resets every maintenance window.

Another virtual real estate crisis was not on my wishlist.
I am tired of camping spawn timers for furniture.
Another balance patch ruining abilities because arenas exist.
I am tired of PvE skills being redesigned around tournament statistics.
Another leaderboard measuring who had the most free time this week.
Please do not make every game an esport.
Another clone chasing a trend that peaked before development started.

Another safe clone is still a clone.

Another game terrified that players might encounter something unfamiliar.

I am tired of needing patch notes to understand my own character.

Another gear score standing between me and content I could clearly survive.
I am tired of legendary meaning temporary.
Another loot explosion full of items destined for the vendor.
I have sorted enough garbage with colored borders.
Another inventory full of crafting materials I am afraid to delete.
I am tired of hoarding because every useless item might matter three patches later.
Another tooltip comparing twelve statistics for gloves.
I have done enough mental arithmetic over fictional pants.
Another build guide followed by ninety percent of the player base.
I am tired of games offering freedom and then balancing around one correct answer.
Another game where experimentation costs currency.
I am tired of being taxed for changing my mind.
Another MMO where the community optimizes the joy out of everything.
I have watched enough players turn adventures into efficient routes.
Another dungeon everybody speedruns past the actual dungeon.
I am tired of being yelled at for stopping to look at the scenery.
Another beautifully designed room seen for four seconds.
I have skipped enough cutscenes because strangers were waiting.
Another community that expects perfect knowledge before first attempt.
I am tired of tutorials taught through public humiliation.
Another MMO where every mistake becomes a performance review.
I do not want quarterly metrics for my wizard.
Another addon needed to tell me what the game should already communicate.
I am tired of installing third-party tools to make the interface usable.
Another screen covered in icons I am expected to memorize.
I am tired of cooldowns looking like spreadsheet cells.
Another beautiful boss fight I experienced entirely through warning overlays.
I have spent enough fantasy battles watching colored bars.
Another encounter where standing anywhere is apparently illegal.
Another particle effect obscuring the mechanic it is supposed to explain.
I have died enough times because the floor was hidden under fireworks.
Another MMO where subtlety was removed for performance reasons.
I am tired of characters looking like illuminated parade floats.
Another shoulder pad large enough to require planning permission.
I have seen enough glowing wings on people standing in banks.
Another serious story occurring beside someone dressed as a giant chicken.
I have accepted that MMOs cannot maintain tone for more than six months.
Another world slowly becoming an advertisement for other worlds.
I am tired of games losing their identity through collaborations.
Please make KOGNABO weird in its own way instead of familiar in everybody else’s.
